CVE-2026-59313/59314: fix is Enterprise-only on Spring 6.2.x (6.2.20) / OSS in 7.x; PCS uses neither SSE functional endpoints nor Content-Disposition built from input. Re-review by the until date.

Fix is Enterprise-only on Spring Framework 6.2.x (6.2.20); OSS 6.2 stops at 6.2.19, so the only open-source remedy is Spring 7.x, i.e. a Spring Boot 4.x upgrade tracked separately. None applies to PCS as deployed: CVE-2026-47892 and CVE-2026-47893 are WebFlux-only (functional endpoints behind DispatcherServlet, and WebFlux WebSockets); spring-webflux is test scope here and resolves 0 times on runtimeClasspath - PCS serves Spring MVC on embedded Tomcat. CVE-2026-59283 is a SimpleEvaluationContext SpEL sandbox bypass; PCS evaluates no SpEL - there is no ExpressionParser/EvaluationContext usage in the source. CVE-2026-59280 is FreeMarker view path traversal; FreeMarker resolves 0 times on runtimeClasspath, PCS templates use Pebble. Re-review by the until date.

CVE-2026-59270: fix is Enterprise-only on Spring Security 6.5.x (6.5.12); OSS 6.5 stops at 6.5.11, so the only open-source remedy is Spring Security 7.x via a Spring Boot 4.x upgrade tracked separately. The vulnerability is in the embedded UnboundID LDAP test server (UnboundIdContainer); PCS uses neither - unboundid and spring-security-ldap resolve 0 times on runtimeClasspath. Re-review by the until date.

CVE-2026-59284: no allow list for property keys when the writable /actuator/env endpoint is enabled. Fixed in Spring Cloud Commons 4.3.4, which is not published to Maven Central (OSS 4.3 stops at 4.3.3); the open-source remedy is Spring Cloud 2026.x / 5.0.3 via a Spring Boot 4.x upgrade tracked separately. PCS does not enable the writable env endpoint - it is disabled by default and nothing in application configuration turns it on. Re-review by the until date.
